fields.previous_round_id: Earlier round for cross-round records; may be non-adjacent
fields.state: accepted | rejected | refused | unresolved | insufficient_evidence | not_comparable | unknown
fields.source_ids: Array of exact supplied source_id values
fields.position: For position: typed stance text, no inferred normalization
fields.movement: concession | hardening | reversal | stable | ambiguous | unknown
fields.actor_ids: Optional participant actor identifiers for cross-actor trajectory or decision-support claims; evidence from both rounds is required for each participant.

directives: Return canonical {agent, doc_id, items} with flat items. doc_id is case_id.
Use only supplied actor, issue, round and source identifiers. Preserve ambiguity and competing interpretations as separate records.
A missing round or absent actor/issue is not evidence of continuity. Non-adjacent comparisons are allowed when explicitly supported.
Cross-round statements need evidence from both named rounds, for the named actor and issue. Keep unsupported claims insufficient_evidence, unknown or not_comparable.
Concession, hardening, reversal, agreement, convergence, divergence and significance are semantic judgments, never conclusions from numeric deltas alone.

Distinguish observed_evidence from semantic_interpretation and recommendation. Do not generate recommendations unless explicitly requested in run objectives. Movement does not automatically justify advice.

Include current positions, histories through individual observations, movements, unresolved issues, persistent disagreements, convergence/divergence, trajectory and decision-support observations only where supported.
For positions include position; for all other kinds include previous_round_id. Movements must link two position records and carry all their source_ids.
The state accepted is a proposal pending independent review. Never claim measured quality or complete coverage.

fields.state: accepted | rejected | refused | unresolved | insufficient_evidence | not_comparable | unknown
fields.source_ids: Copy all source_ids of reviewed proposal

directives: Cross-check each proposal against supplied source evidence and round/actor/issue attribution. Do not draft replacement content. Return one flat review item per target_record_id, or withhold judgment explicitly.
Acceptance does not resolve ambiguity. Preserve UNCERTAIN when evidence admits competing interpretations.
Reject unsupported claims, unsupported continuity, ungrounded advice and self-certifying evidence. Never infer meaning from numeric equality alone.
